'''Mace Man''' is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden'']]''.''

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:MaceManNES1.png|80px]]

First appearing in [[Temple of Darkness -Hall of Demons-|Act 4-3]], Mace Men are potentially one of the most dangerous enemies in the game. They are a palette swap of the [[Banshee]]s and [[Jack O' Murderer]]s and do the same thing, their weapon of choice being maces. Both their contact and mace attacks do 1 damage, and they are best defeated using sub-weapons to work around the maces.
